assignmentHtml.task: Research ISSEI / いっせい YouTube channel comprehensively. Find: (1) Stable channel ID and canonical URL. (2) Operator/creator - who is ISSEI? Japanese creator. (3) Channel creation date and earliest still-public upload. (4) Operating location and displayed country. (5) Languages (Japanese). (6) Primary content category. (7) Content supply model. (8) Representative series. Provide direct source URLs.
assignmentHtml.context: ISSEI / いっせい is #34 with ~62B lifetime views per Communitrics snapshot dated September 2, 2026. Need verifiable facts with source links.
assignmentHtml.expected_output: A structured dossier for ISSEI / いっせい with all requested fields, each with source URLs.

answerHtml:
ISSEI / いっせい YouTube Channel Dossier

(1) Stable Channel ID & Canonical URL:

  • Channel ID: UC6QZ_ss3i_8qLV_RczPZBkw
  • Handle: @issei0806
  • Canonical URL: https://www.youtube.com/@issei0806 (also accessible at https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC6QZ_ss3i_8qLV_RczPZBkw)
  • Source: tubestats.io confirms channel ID; multiple sources confirm handle and canonical URL.

(2) Operator/Creator:

  • Real name: Issei Toita (問田一誠), born August 6, 1999, in Tokyo, Japan
  • Professionally known as ISSEI (いっせい, stylized in all caps)
  • Japanese YouTuber and TikToker; originally pursued acting before pivoting to social media content
  • Was signed to a talent agency until 2019
  • Sources: Wikipedia (EN and JA editions)

(3) Channel Creation Date & Earliest Still-Public Upload:

  • Channel created: July 23, 2014
  • Earliest still-public upload: Unverifiable via available tools. Wikipedia states he "started uploading short-form videos on his YouTube channel in 2021," implying minimal or no public long-form content from 2014–2020. The earliest identifiable public uploads are Shorts compilations from late 2021 (e.g., "ISSEI Best TikTok December 2021 Part 37 #shorts"). The channel's early content from 2014–2020 may have been deleted or privatized.
  • Sources: tubestats.io (creation date); Wikipedia (upload history timeline)

(4) Operating Location & Displayed Country:

  • Operating location: Tokyo, Japan (films daily at a studio in Tokyo)
  • Displayed country: Japan (JP flag)
  • Sources: tubestats.io (country flag JP), Viewstats (country JP, ranked #2), Wikipedia (born in Tokyo)

(5) Languages:

  • Primary language: Japanese
  • Videos are non-verbal (gestures, facial expressions, eye contact), which enabled global reach
  • Auto-dubbed/subtitled in multiple languages for international audiences
  • Sources: Wikipedia list of most-viewed YouTube channels (primary language: Japanese); Wikipedia EN (non-verbal content description)

(6) Primary Content Category:

  • YouTube self-declared categories: Comedy, Family, Food (per tubestats.io)
  • Wikipedia list of most-viewed channels: Entertainment
  • Viewstats: Entertainment (ranked #17 globally)
  • Core format: Short-form non-verbal comedy Shorts
  • Sources: tubestats.io, Wikipedia list of most-viewed channels, Viewstats

(7) Content Supply Model:

  • High-volume daily production: approximately 3 videos/day (~32 videos/month)
  • Total output: ~4,507 videos as of September 2026
  • Team-based production; filming and editing takes 8–10 hours per video
  • Primary format: YouTube Shorts (vertical, <60s non-verbal comedy)
  • Secondary formats: Vlogs (e.g., "[SUB] ISSEI's Vlog" series), travel vlogs, challenge videos, reaction videos
  • Auto-dubbed for 25+ languages to maximize international reach
  • Estimated lifetime revenue: $20.85M (tubestats.io)
  • Sources: Wikipedia, tubestats.io, Social Blade

(8) Representative Series:

  • TRY MAGIC! — Playlist of 173 magic-trick comedy Shorts (3.4M views)
  • VS Mom series — Recurring "vs mom" comedy skits (multiple videos with millions of views)
  • ISSEI Funny Travel Vlog — Travel-themed vlog series (1.2M views)
  • Most viewing short videos Thank you! — Curated compilation playlist (371 videos)
  • I try it! — Reaction/experiment Shorts playlist
  • BODY PUZZLE — Viral overseas hit that helped channel explode in popularity (2022)
  • Sources: YouTube playlists page (via search results), Wikipedia, Facebook official page

Note on Communitrics snapshot: ~62B lifetime views per orchestrator context aligns with Social Blade's 61.86B and tubestats' 61.9B as of mid-September 2026.

Unresolved: Exact identity of the earliest still-public upload could not be verified due to YouTube access restrictions (401 errors). Based on available evidence, the channel's active upload history effectively began in 2021 with Shorts.
